expectedAnswers.summary: Questions are due August 2, 2023 at 4:00 PM PST.
Proposals are due August 25, 2023 at 4:00 PM PST.
The July 25 question deadline was replaced by Amendment 1.
The August 18 proposal deadline was replaced by Amendment 1.
The in-person proposal conference is July 26, 2023 at 10:00 AM PST.
Proposals must be submitted through ePro and/or as a hard copy with original signature; email and fax are not accepted.
Proposers must register in ePro before submission or be disqualified.
The proposal must be signed by someone authorized to bind the proposer.
Attachment A is the cover page and must be completed and signed.
Copies of required licenses, permits, and certifications belong in Attachment C.
The cost sheet must be submitted separately, through ePro or as hard copy.
Three comparable references must be supplied on Attachment F.
Attachment J must be completed and signed by the insurance broker or agent.
Commercial general liability is at least $5 million per occurrence with a $2 million aggregate.
Automobile liability is at least $1 million per occurrence, or $2 million when transporting non-employees.
Professional liability is at least $1 million with a $2 million aggregate.
Guards must carry a permanent DCA guard registration card; temporary cards are unacceptable.
Qualifications and experience 35%, technical review 35%, references 10%, and presentation 20%.
Addendum 3 changes guard-concern and post-order reporting requirements and metrics.
